description: Residuos Peligrosos - Movimientos transfronterizos is a dataset listed in Mexican national open data portal (datos.gob.mx), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría de Medio Ambiente y Recursos Naturales (SEMARNAT). Importación y exportación internacional de residuos que posean alguna de las características de corrosividad, reactividad, explosividad, toxicidad, inflamabilidad, o que contengan agentes infecciosos que les confieran peligrosidad, así como envases, recipientes, embalajes y suelos que hayan sido contaminados cuando se transfieran a otro sitio. Coverage: México. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría de Medio Ambiente y Recursos Naturales (SEMARNAT). Its tags are contaminación, contaminante, eliminación desechos, gestión ambiental. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-06-17 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mx-portal.
